example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চোখ ফোটালো এবং পরিস্থিতির প্রতি সতর্ক হলো।
এই ঘটনায় তার চোখ ফুটে গেছে, এখন সে আর ভুল করবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He opened his eyes and became cautious about the situation.
This incident has opened his eyes; now he won't make the same mistake again.
note: The idiom metaphorically refers to gaining awareness, akin to eyes opening to reality; the suffix '৪' in input appears to be a numbering artifact.
